newsitem.title: USA: US gasoline strength leads IPE oil futures higher=.
newsitem.headline: US gasoline strength leads IPE oil futures higher=.

text.p: Weekly American Petroleum Institute data are due for release after the market closes tonight. In recent weeks there has been heavy buying of gasoline in anticipation of bullish stock draws, in the hours before the data appears.

Earlier Brent and gas oil were positive, buoyed by technical factors. The markets shed the effect of Monday's announcement by Iraq that it hoped to export 30 million barrels of crude by the end of August.
Brent's next upside target was seen at $18.80, with analysts saying that even if that level was not breached they still expected a further consolidation before long term gains.
"It (Brent) requires an increase in momentum to get above this level ($18.80) in the very short term," said brokers GNI in its market report.
"Overall its a case of 'wait and see' in the short term but the medium term charts still look okay for the crude oil bulls," it added.
